# CocoStudy

> CocoStudy is an AI-powered, offline-first study companion that turns lectures, slide decks, PDFs, and notes into interactive study guides, spaced repetition flashcards, customizable quizzes, and a personal AI tutor.

CocoStudy runs in the browser. All study sets, notes, flashcards, and progress are stored locally in IndexedDB, and AI features call Google Gemini directly with the user's own API key.
A pre-loaded demo study set ("Spaced Repetition and the Forgetting Curve") lets anyone try every feature without an account or API key.
Flashcards use an adaptive SM-2 scheduler; a card counts as mastered once its review interval reaches 21 days.
CocoStudy is open source under the MIT License and built by Zaki Nazzal.

## Pages

- [CocoStudy app](https://cocostudy.space/): the study companion itself, with intake, notes, flashcards, quizzes, and tutor
- [About CocoStudy](https://cocostudy.space/about.html): what the app does, how it handles data, and who builds it
